svg.aria-label: Web app, mobile app and external clients call an API gateway that handles authentication, rate limiting and routing; the gateway routes to six microservices: order, product, payment, user, notification and inventory. Operational infrastructure supports the services: service discovery, load balancing, configuration management, observability, container orchestration with Kubernetes, and a deployment pipeline. It runs on an infrastructure layer of cloud or on-premise compute, a container runtime, and networking
svg.text: Behind the services sits a layer of shared operational services, which runs on the infrastructure layer.
